INTRD DATS
SUNE 11,2026

Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat,,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
16-D in the area bound by:

East 69th Place; South Harper Avenue: the public alley next south of and parallel to
East 69th Place; and a line 84 feet next west of and parallel to South Harper Avenue

to those of RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1469 E. 69th Place, Chicago, Illinois
